name: Nirasaki Hinata
source:
Hinata lives with her father in the same apartment block as the protagonist and is his kouhai. She’s an energetic girl and loves running, in fact, she’s the star of the track club at school. She’s a pretty good cook too since she normally has to cook for herself since her father works long hours.

As her looks suggest, she isn’t very good at studying. She is very energetic and friendly, but is shy around strangers. Since her mother died when she was young, she learned how to do housework to lessen the burden on her father. She is very reserved and rarely acts selfishly.
